en: The postcard shows a sepia-toned image of a square with a prominent statue in the center, depicting a standing figure on a pedestal. The background features historic brick buildings with stepped gables, typical of Flemish architecture. The location is nearly empty, with only one person visible near the statue. There is printed text in French identifying the place and statue as 'Memling' in Bruges.
